_: VENDOR TRUTH — read out of TradingView's own chart model on 2026-09-08. This is the P7.2 pin, and it answers the semantic the directive called the most important unresolved question in the wave: what does history mean for a UDF call site that does NOT execute on every chart bar?
method: study model read — _exposed_chartWidgetCollection -> activeChartWidget -> model().model().dataSources() -> study.data().each(). Never a screenshot, never the Data Window, never the editor DOM.
_probe_shape: A UDF is called from ONE source call site inside `if go`, where `go = bar_index % 3 == 0`. The function is handed `bar_index`, so every value is self-labelling: a result of A-3 means 'three chart bars back' and A-6 means 'six'. The gap of 3 is what makes the hypotheses separate — with a gap of 1 they all coincide.

shallow_v5.source:
//@version=5
indicator("UCT skipcall probe")
f1(v) => v[1]
f2(v) => v[2]
go = bar_index % 3 == 0
float p1 = na
float p2 = na
if go
    p1 := f1(bar_index)
    p2 := f2(bar_index)
plot(bar_index, "A")
plot(p1, "B")
plot(p2, "C")
plot(go ? 1 : 0, "D")

hypotheses.A1_chart_bar_na_on_skip: a skipped bar leaves the function-local series `na`, so v[1] on a call bar right after two skips is `na`
hypotheses.A2_chart_bar_hold_on_skip: the series is indexed by CHART BAR and HOLDS its last value across skipped bars: v[1]=v[2]=v[3]=A-3 and v[4]=A-6
hypotheses.B_per_invocation: history counts INVOCATIONS, not bars: v[1]=A-3 and v[2]=A-6
hypotheses.C_clamp_to_last_execution: every offset returns the last executed value: v[1]=v[2]=v[3]=v[4]=A-3
hypotheses.D_evaluated_every_bar: the call runs on every bar despite the `if`, so v[1]=A-1

discrimination.v1_and_v2_both_A_minus_3: excludes B (per-invocation would give A-6 for v[2]), excludes A1 (would be na), excludes D (would give A-1)
discrimination.v3_is_A_minus_3_but_v4_is_A_minus_6: excludes C (clamp would give A-3 for BOTH). Only A2 survives: the third bar back is still the held value, the fourth reaches the previous execution.
discrimination._note: A gap of 3 is essential. The shallow probe alone cannot separate A2 from C, and the deep probe alone cannot separate A2 from B. Together they leave exactly one model.

conclusion.rule: FUNCTION-LOCAL SERIES HISTORY IS INDEXED BY CHART BAR. On a bar where the call site does NOT execute, the series HOLDS its previous value.
rejects: the call being evaluated on every bar despite the `if`
conclusion.implication_for_uct: a per-call-site history ring is committed EVERY chart bar, using the value the site last produced — so a skipped call re-commits the previous value rather than advancing or blanking. The live frame local still resets per invocation; only the committed series holds.

not_observed.warmup_at_the_first_bar_of_history: the returned window begins at bar_index 8060, so the first bar of the call site's life is outside it. Still NOT vendor-pinned (carried from the 2F-2A fixture).
not_observed.committed_na_history_value: a call site whose committed value is itself `na` was not probed. Still NOT vendor-pinned.
not_observed.two_distinct_call_sites_to_one_udf_with_: the 2E fixture pins per-call-site PERSISTENT STATE; per-call-site HISTORY identity is implemented to match it but is not separately vendor-pinned here.
